title: Top-Floor 1BR w/ Updated Kitchen & Bath + App-Operated Laundry | Noe V
body:
Top-Floor 1BR w/ Updated Kitchen & Bath + App-Operated Laundry | Noe Valley

Property Address
442 Elizabeth Street | 07 | San Francisco, CA 94114
Available: Now

Offered By
Gaetani Real Estate



Description
$3,695 | 442 Elizabeth St #07, San Francisco, CA 94114

This newly remodeled 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment is situated in the Noe Valley neighborhood, just steps away from Whole Foods. Offering both convenience and style, it features ample windows, a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and extra benefits like on-site laundry and parking. The vibrant neighborhood is near delightful cafes and restaurants on 24th Street. Don't miss the chance – schedule a tour today!

Walk Score: 98 / 100 (Walker's Paradise)

KEY FEATURES:

• Large windows for ample natural light
• Full kitchen w/ stainless steel appliances
• App-operated laundry on-site
• Ample closet space
• Top floor
• Great location

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Credit Score of 650+
• Monthly income of 3x the amount of rent
• Positive references

TERMS:

• 1 year lease
• Security Deposit = 1 month's rent
• Water and garbage included, tenant pays PG&E
• Pets are OK
• Available now!

Contact Megan for more information or to schedule a tour!
